sources.title: Karsus' Compulsion

summary: Lets a full illithid channel Karsus’ Compulsion against the Netherbrain.

fields.Karsus’ Compulsion: Level 9 Action at up to 20 ft. A full illithid channels at the Crown of Karsus until its next turn. Incapacitated, Stunned, Polymorphed or Knocked Out interrupts it. Successful channeling opens the route to dominate the Netherbrain.
fields.Assembly: Automatically combine Gortash’s, Ketheric’s and Orin’s Netherstones during Confront the Elder Brain.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
